description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Cohort' class within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It tests cohort creation, membership management, set operations (union, subtract, intersect), and active membership queries.

classes.name: CohortTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of the Cohort class in various scenarios.

methods.name: constructorWithIntegers_shouldAddMembersToCohort
methods.description: Tests constructing a Cohort with an array of integer IDs and verifies each ID is contained within the cohort.

methods.name: constructorWithPatients_shouldAddMembersToCohort
methods.description: Tests constructing a Cohort with a list of Patient objects and verifies their IDs are contained.

methods.name: constructorWithCommaSeparatedIntegers_shouldAddMembersToCohort
methods.description: Tests constructing a Cohort using a comma-separated string of IDs.

methods.name: getCommaSeparatedPatientIds_shouldReturnCommaSeparatedListOfPatients
methods.description: Verifies that the cohort correctly returns comma-separated patient IDs.

methods.name: union_shouldContainVoidedAndExpiredMemberships
methods.description: Tests the union operation on two cohorts, ensuring voided and expired memberships are included.

methods.name: subtract_shouldContainVoidedAndExpiredMemberships
methods.description: Tests the subtract operation, verifying memberships remaining after subtraction includes the correct voided and expired ones.

methods.name: intersect_shouldContainVoidedAndExpiredMemberships
methods.description: Tests the intersection of two cohorts, checking that only overlapping voided and expired memberships are retained.

methods.name: setMemberIds_shouldSupportLargeCohorts
methods.description: Checks the performance of setting a large number of member IDs in a cohort, ensuring it completes within a timeframe.

methods.name: contains_shouldOnlyContainNonVoidedMembersAndIgnoreActiveStatus
methods.description: Verifies that the cohort's contains() method considers only non-voided members and ignores their active status.

methods.name: contains_shouldOnlyContainNonVoidedMembers
methods.description: Checks that voided members are excluded from containment checks.

methods.name: size_shouldOnlyCountNonVoidedMembers
methods.description: Verifies that size() counts only non-voided members.

methods.name: hasActiveMembership_shouldFindAnActiveMemberCorrectly
methods.description: Tests if the cohort correctly identifies active memberships based on end date and void status.

methods.name: activeMembershipSize_shouldDetermineSizeCorrectly
methods.description: Checks that activeMembershipSize() returns the count of non-voided, active memberships.

methods.name: hasNoActiveMemberships_shouldReturnTrueIfNoneExists
methods.description: Verifies that the cohort reports no active memberships when all are voided or expired.

methods.name: hasNoActiveMemberships_shouldReturnFalseIfOneExists
methods.description: Checks that the cohort correctly reports the presence of an active membership.
